items.title: Milk allergen in liver pâté
items.label: EU RASFF information notification for attention
items.detail: Product: meat and meat products (other than poultry). Risk: potentially serious. Reported by France. Reference 2024.6714.

items.title: Presence of hydroxyanthracene derivatives in food supplement from Monaco
items.label: EU RASFF alert notification
items.detail: Product: dietetic foods, food supplements and fortified foods. Risk: serious. Reported by Luxembourg. Reference 2022.7229.

items.title: Ethylene oxide in food supplement capsules (HPMC) from Monaco
items.label: EU RASFF alert notification
items.detail: Product: dietetic foods, food supplements and fortified foods. Risk: serious. Reported by Luxembourg. Reference 2022.1232.

items.title: Detention Without Physical Examination Bulk Shipments of High-Risk Bovine Tissue from BSE-Countries--Bovine Spongiform Encephalopathy
items.label: FDA import alert 17-04
items.detail: The U.S. FDA can detain these products from listed firms in Monaco at the border (DWPE). Alert last updated 12/10/2020.
